purpose: Evaluate online MLE utility of decision-admissible memory under protocol-aligned, label-isolated terminal evaluation. This design does not authorize a superiority claim before the frozen results and statistics pass verification.

freeze_sequence.phase_1: This file freezes the design, algorithms, systems, seeds, ordering, budgets, source inputs and failure policy.
freeze_sequence.phase_2: A separately verified formal staging manifest must bind the post-implementation source snapshot, every derived holdout, every derived memory Bundle, each CURRENT pointer, container image, candidate contract and output root before the first formal training Pod starts.
freeze_sequence.revision_rule: Any semantic change requires a new preregistration_id and a new immutable file; this r1 file must remain preserved.

source_inputs.source_relation: build only from the labeled training image population; do not reuse the old binary-ROC-AUC holdout as the formal split

holdout_builder.allocation: within each binary class, sort by ordering_key and assign max(1, floor(class_count * 0.20)) rows to terminal holdout
holdout_builder.physical_views: training labels/images and unlabeled terminal images are materialized into separate train_view/input and evaluator_view roots using copied files, never hardlinks

source_inputs.source_relation: use only the 322 publicly labeled fold0 records; all fold1 question-mark labels remain excluded

holdout_builder.label_columns: the 19 class IDs in species_list.txt, serialized as wide binary columns
holdout_builder.group_rule: remove the terminal underscore plus four decimal digits from the WAV filename stem
holdout_builder.allocation: sort unique fold0 groups by ordering_key and assign ceil(group_count * 0.25) groups to terminal holdout
holdout_builder.physical_views: copy fold0 WAV files into disjoint train_wavs and test_wavs trees; training CSV contains labels only for training groups
holdout_builder.fail_closed_rule: If deterministic r1 allocation fails label coverage, do not rearrange groups post hoc; preserve the failed staging root and issue a new preregistration revision.

holdout_builder.allocation: sampled rows before terminal_cutoff are training; sampled rows at or after terminal_cutoff are terminal holdout
holdout_builder.physical_views: train.csv contains past labels; test.csv contains future features without fare_amount; evaluator labels contain only key and fare_amount

online_systems.semantics: Bind the same immutable Bundle and protocol as paired memory systems, but expose zero clauses, zero RunForest nodes and zero memory text.

Within the hard same-domain/domain-general source universe, rank clauses by flat textual relevance only. Ignore Claim Authority, Operation, Protocol and current Stage. This is an intentionally weak baseline; it may expose invalid source content but never target holdout labels.
Evaluate clauses using the full current Operation, Protocol, Task and Stage request. If any clause in an SOP is denied, suppress the entire SOP before ranking; otherwise expose the intact SOP.

Apply Claim-level Authority, Operation, Protocol and Task/domain gates before flat relevance ranking, but marginalize over Stage: a clause is eligible if it is authorized in at least one declared generation/governance stage.

Apply pre-prompt Claim-level Authority for the exact current Operation, Protocol, Task/domain and generation/governance Stage, then use stage-aware SOP/RunForest routing over only the visible clauses.

oracle.construction: For each task and agent seed, the CPU evaluator scores the frozen union of all candidate submissions produced by the five online systems and selects the protocol-legal best candidate as a host-side upper bound.
oracle.interpretation: upper bound only, not a deployable memory system

memory_bundle_contract.hard_domain_rule: Every online system, including Flat, receives only same-domain method content or explicitly domain-general guardrails. Cross-domain and unknown-source method content is forbidden.
memory_bundle_contract.provisional_method_rule: A clean, manifest-bound source execution may authorize a same-domain METHOD_HYPOTHESIS for GENERATE_CANDIDATE without clean-replay certification. It cannot authorize source Score inheritance, Rank, Select, Promote, positive-result distillation or a target Result Fact.
memory_bundle_contract.formal_child_bundle_requirement: All formal runs use newly published, immutable, validator-clean child Bundles with domain lineage, protocol registry binding, artifact hashes and a separately hash-bound CURRENT pointer. Raw WP4 Bundles are not mounted directly as enforce memory.

condition_order_design.method: nine distinct sequences from a ten-sequence balanced Latin/Williams construction for five online systems; across the nine task-seed blocks each system occupies each position either once or twice
condition_order_design.oracle_position: host-side only after all five online candidate sets are frozen

selection_and_terminal_evaluation.system_selected_node: Before any terminal labels are mounted, the training process freezes exactly one selected_node_id per online condition using the solver's internal search-only metric and records its code, submission hash, selection basis and candidate-set hash in a v3 evaluation request.
selection_and_terminal_evaluation.system_metric: The CPU evaluator reports the terminal metric of the preselected node. It must not replace that node with the terminal-best candidate.
selection_and_terminal_evaluation.oracle_metric: The CPU evaluator may additionally score all frozen submissions solely to construct the declared per-task/per-seed Oracle upper bound.
selection_and_terminal_evaluation.writeback: PROMOTE_RESULT and the independent Result Fact use only the preselected node and selected terminal score. Oracle selection never writes a normal system Result Fact.
selection_and_terminal_evaluation.adoption_and_causal: Result Fact derived_from_refs remains empty. Adoption requires static plus runtime actuation; Causal additionally requires a memory-on/off counterfactual. Their absence never blocks an independent clean Result Fact.
selection_and_terminal_evaluation.old_best_terminal_behavior: The canary-era practice of treating terminal-best among all submissions as the system result is forbidden for formal Tier-2.

training_mounts: one selected formal memory Bundle read-only
solver environment secret as a single read-only file
pod_and_label_isolation.ordering: For each task-seed block: run and freeze all five conditions in one paired GPU devpod, delete that GPU Pod and verify NotFound, then start a separate CPU evaluator devpod.

failure_and_retry_policy.exclusion_rule: No condition, seed or task is excluded after observing a terminal metric. Every exclusion and retry must be classified from pre-metric infrastructure evidence and retained in the Evidence Ledger.

analysis_plan.utility_orientation: macro_f1 is used directly; RMSE deltas are sign-flipped so positive paired utility deltas favor the first-named system
analysis_plan.primary_online_contrast: full_decision_admissibility minus no_memory, paired within task and agent_seed
analysis_plan.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm over the four declared Full contrasts
uncertainty: paired seed deltas with numerator and denominator
task-stratified effect sizes and confidence intervals
mixed-effects model with task as random intercept when estimable
analysis_plan.cross_task_aggregation: Never average raw macro-F1 and RMSE. Cross-task summaries use paired win/tie/loss counts and within-task standardized utility deltas, alongside every native-metric result.
analysis_plan.oracle_gap: For each task-seed block report Oracle utility minus each system utility; do not select the best seed.
analysis_plan.paper_claim_rule: Infrastructure completion does not imply Full superiority. If the declared effect gate fails, retain the complete result and shrink the paper claim rather than changing systems, tasks, seeds or exclusions.

formal_stop_gate.effect_claim_gate: A Full-superiority statement is permitted only if the frozen corrected contrast supports it with directionally consistent task-level evidence and reported uncertainty. Otherwise effect_claim_authorized is false.
formal_stop_gate.next_authority_after_pass: WP8 evidence synthesis and final independent Claude-agent review only after code, data processing, formal execution, statistics and full tests are complete.

claims_not_authorized_by_preregistration: The derived holdouts or formal child Bundles already exist.
All candidate dependencies are available in the training image.
Full Decision Admissibility improves any target metric.
